name: codealong
description: Coding tutorials that wait for you. Pauses the video in Chrome while you type and continues when you're done.
author: Sebastian Westin Ingebrigtsen

codealong.enabled.description: Let CodeAlong pause and continue the tutorial automatically. Turn off to keep CodeAlong installed but inactive.

codealong.pauseOnTyping.description: Pause the tutorial as soon as you start editing code.

codealong.resumeAfterIdle.markdownDescription: Continue the tutorial when you have stopped typing for `#codealong.idleDelaySeconds#` seconds.

codealong.idleDelaySeconds.description: How many seconds without typing count as "done".

codealong.resumeOnSave.description: Treat saving a file (Ctrl+S / Cmd+S) as "done" and continue about a second later, unless you keep typing. Auto save is ignored.

codealong.resumeOnTutorialFocus.description: Continue when you switch back to the tutorial tab in Chrome. Useful on a single screen; with two screens it may continue when you only click the browser.

codealong.rewindBeforeResume.description: Rewind a little before continuing automatically, so you hear the end of what the instructor was saying.

codealong.rewindSeconds.description: How many seconds to rewind before continuing automatically.

codealong.debugLogging.markdownDescription: Write every CodeAlong event to the **CodeAlong** output channel (for troubleshooting). Your code is never logged.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with CodeAlong
walkthroughs.description: Coding tutorials that wait for you. Set up in under a minute.

steps.title: Add CodeAlong to Chrome
steps.description:
CodeAlong has two halves: this VS Code extension notices when you code, and a small Chrome extension pauses and plays the video. Both are needed, and they talk to each other only on your computer.
[Get the Chrome Extension](command:codealong.getChromeExtension)

steps.title: Follow a tutorial
steps.description: Open a tutorial in Chrome (YouTube, Laracasts, Vimeo or any site with a normal video player), click the CodeAlong icon in the toolbar and choose **Follow this tab**. The status bar in VS Code then shows **CodeAlong: Tutorial Playing**.

steps.title: Just code
steps.description: Start typing and the tutorial pauses. Stop typing for a few seconds, or save the file, and it continues, rewound by two seconds. If you pause the video yourself, CodeAlong never starts it again on its own.

steps.title: Stay in control
steps.description:
Use **Ctrl+Alt+P** (⌃⌥P on macOS) to pause or play and **Ctrl+Alt+D** (⌃⌥D) to continue right away. Click **CodeAlong** in the status bar to turn it off for a while or change the timing.
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22codealong%22%5D)
